He reflects on Ireland’s rich creative & interesting newsprints and talks about the content of it throughout this length paragraph. He also comments on the “official gazette” as boring, especially compared to it.

M.A.P. stands for Mainly About People, and published “pleasant gossip, personal portraits and social news.” It also had several pages of ads, and a few tips for investors.
